text: The School of Nursing of Wenzhou Medical University is a secondary school of Wenzhou Medical University. It is the 5th international training school for ostomists in China, a specialist nurse in Zhejiang Province and a primary ambulance training base of Wenzhou Red Cross Society.Wenzhou Medical University began to enroll full-time nursing students in 1998, established the School of Nursing in 2001, enrolled undergraduate nursing students in the same year, began to enroll nursing graduate students in 2006, and began to enroll midwifery students in 2018.As of October 2020, the College has 4 teaching and research departments, 2 undergraduate majors and 1 junior major.Department specialtyAs of October 2020, the college has four teaching and research sections, namely, Basic Nursing Teaching and Research Section, Humanistic Nursing teaching and Research Section, Clinical Nursing Teaching and Research Section and Clinical Nursing teaching and Research section. It offers two undergraduate majors of midwifery and nursing, and one junior major of nursing.Teaching constructionAs of October 2020, the college has national first-class undergraduate major construction point, Zhejiang Province "Twelfth Five-Year" and "thirteenth Five-Year" advantage of one major, Zhejiang Province key major 1, nursing undergraduate professional through the National Ministry of Education undergraduate certification, there are 56 clinical internship base.National first-class undergraduate major construction point: nursingZhejiang Province "Twelfth Five-Year" "thirteenth Five-Year" advantage specialty: nursingZhejiang Province key major: nursingDiscipline constructionAs of October 2020, the college has 1 master's degree in first-level disciplines and 1 key discipline in Zhejiang universities.Master's degree in first-level discipline: NursingKey discipline of universities in Zhejiang Province: Nursing
